paragraphs.text: Accountant is an unreleased acorn class for those who keep, inspect, and analyse financial accounts.

Accountant was a creature type that was designed for Unglued 2: The Obligatory Sequel before it was canceled. It was for a card called Bob from Accounting which represented a specific red skinned humanoid accountant named Bob. Bob had previously appeared in an old commercial for Magic: The Gathering .
Accountants are not common in the Multiverse due to it being a more modern profession and the term has yet to appear on any printed card.
